name: Binu zhi Tong
source:
A maiden (Meme) from another world is trying to summon you to help her prevent an assassination that is going to happen in 30 days.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1213000/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
來自異世界的少女Meme正試圖召喚你，幫助她阻止一場將在30天後發生的刺殺事件。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1213000/]Steam[/url]］
